about.title: About Our Accomodation
about.subtitle: We cordially invite you to our family accomodation Ubytování Nikol, located in the quiet Brno district of Horní Heršpice, close to the popular cycling path and golf course. The historic city center is just 5 minutes drive away. Our vacation will be enjoyed by couples, families with children, as well as sports enthusiasts and lovers of monuments.

roomsCapacity.title: Our Rooms and Capacity
roomsCapacity.description: We offer you comfortable accommodation all year round with a total capacity of 10 beds in these comfortable rooms:
items: • triple room with terrace (double and single bed)
• four-bed apartment with balcony (double and single bed in bedroom + single bed in living room)

equipment.title: Room Equipment
equipment.description1: All rooms have TV with satellite reception, refrigerator and electric kettle (coffee and tea in every room) in addition to beds.
equipment.description2: The apartment has a living space with a comfortable bed, TV (satellite) and balcony access compared to other rooms. In its own kitchenette you can also use an electric stove, microwave, electric kettle, refrigerator, toaster, toaster and bar seating. There is also a crib in the apartment bedroom.
equipment.description3: Private bathrooms with shower and toilet are a matter of course for each accommodation unit. Only the apartment is equipped with a spacious corner bath instead of a shower. We have ensured free WiFi internet connection throughout the building.

services.title: Services and Comfort
services.description: The stay also includes daily serving of delicious breakfast in our dining room (except for the apartment - possibility to order additionally). You can enjoy nice weather and fresh air on the balconies and terraces with seating. You can park your cars either directly at the building (2 fenced places) or in the adjacent parking lot.

surroundings.title: Surroundings and Activities
surroundings.description1: The fantastic strategic location of the accommodation will take you on trips to the nearer and farther surroundings. Right next door you will find a children's playground where your little ones will have plenty of fun. But they will certainly be most pleased by the local farm with domestic and more exotic animals. Together you will see not only horses, donkeys and sheep, but also deer, kangaroos, bison and many others.
surroundings.description2: Our accomodation is also directly located on a 15 km long inline track. Cyclists and skaters are taken care of. Golfers will use the Kšírovka driving range, behind which there is also a natural biotope. This is ideal for swimming and cooling off during hot summer days.

brno.title: Brno and its Monuments
brno.description1: Our beautiful city of course also offers you plenty of interesting opportunities for quality leisure time. Walking through historic streets, restaurants, cafes, visiting attractions and monuments, you will definitely not be bored.
brno.description2: We recommend you visit the Mendel Museum, St. Peter's and Paul's Cathedral, Dietrichstein Palace, Reduta Theater, Vegetable Market, Brno Astronomical Clock, Starobrno Brewery or Špilberk Castle.
brno.conclusion: We firmly believe that you will truly fall in love with your stay at Accommodation Nikol, rest excellently and return to us with joy! We look forward to your visit!
